definition: the ability to make new and original things
description: A sunny street market with coloured bunting overhead. A young man walks towards the camera down the cobbled lane as a one-man band made from things at hand: he plays an acoustic guitar and a harmonica with a small horn at his mouth, a frying pan on a pole above his head, and a saucepan, spoons, a cheese grater and a tambourine swing from his body, with an old suitcase on his back. Behind him young people clap and cheer, and a young woman waves a bunch of tulips beside the fruit and flower stalls.

en.question: What is the young man doing?

de.answer: Er spielt auf der Straße Gitarre.
de.question: Was macht der junge Mann?

es.answer: Está tocando la guitarra en la calle.

fr.answer: Il joue de la guitare dans la rue.
